name: web-learnnova-e-learning-case-study-cover-with-tag-labels-and-tape
title: LearnNova e-learning case study cover with cursor tag labels and a yellow caution-tape banner
whatItIs: A pale lavender cover with the 'LearnNova' wordmark (lightbulb 'N'), blue pill labels with cursor arrows (E-Learning, UI/UX Design, Web Design, Case Study), a desktop screen of the learning dashboard with mentor photos, and a lime tape strip repeating the disciplines across the bottom.
whatItMeans: Energetic and organised; cursor labels feel like a live design file.
techniques: Label a cover with Figma-style cursor tags.
Run a repeating tape strip across the bottom.
Frame the main screen between cropped side screens.

vocabulary.definition: A pill with a pointer like a collaborator's cursor.
A strip of repeated text like barrier tape.
